name: pyas-devkit
description: Pyas's developer kit: the SDK, the CLI, the MCP server, tools for AI frameworks, starter templates, the Claude Code skill and the Postman collection.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @pyas/sdk && npm run build -w @pyas/ai-tools && npm run build -w @pyas/mcp && npm run build -w @pyas/cli
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @pyas/sdk && npm run typecheck -w @pyas/ai-tools && npm run typecheck -w @pyas/mcp && npm run typecheck -w @pyas/cli && npm run typecheck -w @pyas/postman && tsc --noEmit -p evals/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p templates/tsconfig.json
